one_line_description: Observability and security monitoring platform for cloud-scale applications, metrics, and logs.

credential_access.notes: 14-day full feature free trial allows self-serve generation of API and Application keys; paid subscription required thereafter.

mcp.notes: Vendor-supported MCP server created by Datadog team; Composio provides Datadog toolkit.

buildability.blocker: Active paid subscription required for developer credentials/API access
buildability.rationale: Free tier does not provide developer API keys or webhooks access; commercial subscription is required.

evidence.title: Datadog API Authentication Reference
evidence.excerpt: All requests to Datadog’s API must be authenticated with an API key (DD-API-KEY) and, for modifying operations, an Application key (DD-APPLICATION-KEY).
